Instrument (EN): Coping and Adaptation Processing Scale–Short Form — Colombian caregiver validation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Recursive and focused; Alert and systematic processing; Physical and fixed; Knowing and relating (Colombia 4-factor model; reported 8+2+3+2 items by factor).
Research provenance: Gutiérrez-López et al., International Journal of Nursing Studies Advances 2026 Jan 27, DOI 10.1016/j.ijnsa.2026.100497. Colombian adaptation of Roy's Coping and Adaptation Processing Scale–Short Form. Spanish caregivers of post-COVID-19 patients: pilot N100, later factor validation N182; 15 final retained respondent items and 4 factors. Overall alpha approx .82 and omega approx .89; factors with 2–3 items low alpha approx .47–.55. Specialist caregiving context.
